description: `MARKER_DEFAULTS` (runtime/loop/ledger-publish.mjs:372) is declared as a module-level constant combining `MARKER_SOURCE_DEFAULTS` into the full marker shape (`{ wake, earn, lastPushTs: 0, publishFailureStreak: 0 }`) but has zero call sites anywhere in the file -- `readMarker()`'s own catch-block (ledger-publish.mjs:389) independently re-literals the identical object shape by hand instead of returning `MARKER_DEFAULTS`. This is dead code (an unused export-less const) plus a duplicated literal of the exact same default shape in two places, which is exactly the kind of drift-prone duplication the project's own conventions flag ('容赦なく削除する' -- ruthless deletion of unused code, and 'MANY SMALL FILES > FEW LARGE FILES: high cohesion, low coupling' / no duplicated logic). It is low-impact today (the two literals are currently in sync), but if a future change to the marker shape updates one and not the other, `readMarker`'s fallback would silently diverge from `MARKER_DEFAULTS` with no test catching it, since nothing references the constant to keep it honest.
